skill.name: ad-account-auditor
skill.description: Audits exported paid media data for incremental contribution, wasted spend, measurement integrity, claims, placement safety, and readiness to launch or scale.
skill.summary: Score paid ad account evidence with a typed 20-item ROAS framework and verified veto controls.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: All 38 static findings are false positives based on their surrounding context. The skill contains no prompt injection, exfiltration, unsafe account mutation, or unauthorized persistence intent. Two low-severity concerns remain: unused network permission and missing data-minimization guidance for order or lead identifiers.

remediation.issue: The skill grants WebFetch although its audit workflow uses exported data and local immutable references.
remediation.suggestion: Remove WebFetch or document required domains, purpose, and explicit user approval for every network request.

remediation.issue: CRM and commerce exports may contain customer or lead identifiers without explicit minimization guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Require hashed internal identifiers and exclude names, email addresses, phone numbers, and unrelated customer fields.

content.user_title: Audit Paid Ad Accounts Before Scaling
content.value_statement: Paid media reports can hide attribution inflation, wasted spend, and measurement gaps. This skill evaluates exported evidence against a typed 20-item ROAS framework and returns a governed launch or scale gate.
actual_capabilities: Normalizes currency, attribution windows, conversion lag, identifiers, and account scope before comparing performance.
Scores 20 criteria across return, offer, audience, and spend efficiency using one of three declared profiles.
Separates deduplicated own-data outcomes from platform attribution and labels proxy incrementality.
Verifies veto controls for tracking, double counting, claims, platform policy, and placement safety.
Returns a SHIP, FIX, BLOCK, or UNDECIDED gate with confidence, unknowns, and prioritized remediation.
Produces an authorized audit artifact only when the validated root runtime is available.
limitations: Requires normalized exports and declared currency, attribution window, conversion lag, business constraint, goal, and observation date.
Cannot produce a trusted score in a standalone install without the deterministic root scorer.
Does not change campaigns, bids, budgets, audiences, or account settings.
Cannot establish causal incrementality without suitable holdout, geographic split, or causal test evidence.

use_cases.title: Approve a Budget Increase
use_cases.description: Check measurement integrity, marginal return, placement safety, and operating controls before increasing account spend.

use_cases.title: Reconcile Reported Conversions
use_cases.description: Compare platform conversions with deduplicated business outcomes and identify material attribution inflation or missing evidence.

use_cases.title: Review Launch Readiness
use_cases.description: Verify claims, disclosures, restricted-category requirements, placement evidence, and measurement controls before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Readiness Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these account and outcome exports for direct response. Use USD, a 7-day click window, 3-day lag, and a $120 CAC ceiling.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before a routine budget or launch decision.

prompt_templates.title: Check Attribution Integrity
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare platform conversions with deduplicated CRM outcomes. Identify attribution inflation, missing evidence, and any R1 or R2 veto conditions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when platform and business reporting disagree.

prompt_templates.title: Score a Prospecting Portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the prospecting profile for this portfolio. Normalize currencies, windows, conversion lag, audience overlap, placements, and claims before assigning all 20 states.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when evaluating acquisition quality across several campaigns.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Incremental Profit
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the incremental-profit profile using holdout, order-ID, margin, placement, claims, and change-history exports. Provide traceable evidence, confidence, vetoes, and rerun conditions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a rigorous scale decision with causal evidence.

output_examples.input: Complete direct-response evidence with a raw score of 78 and no verified veto failures.
output_examples.output: SHIP. The direct-response score is 78 with complete coverage. Measurement, claims, policy, and placement controls passed without a verified veto.

output_examples.input: Complete evidence with a raw score of 78 and a verified R1 instrumentation failure.
output_examples.output: FIX. The verified tracking failure caps the final score at 59. Repair instrumentation, validate against own-data outcomes, and rerun the audit.

output_examples.input: Account exports are complete, but the placement report is missing.
output_examples.output: UNDECIDED. Placement safety remains unknown, so no overall score is issued. Provide the placement report before a launch or scale decision.

best_practices: Provide exports from the same observation period and normalize currency, attribution windows, and conversion lag.
Hash customer and lead identifiers, and remove unrelated personal data before sharing exports.
Treat missing evidence as unknown and rerun the audit after each verified remediation.
anti_patterns: Do not treat platform-reported ROAS as independent proof of incremental profit.
Do not convert missing evidence into a pass, failure, or not-applicable state.
Do not use the audit to change spend, bids, targeting, or account settings without separate approval.

faq.question: What data does the audit require?
faq.answer: Provide campaign, outcome, economics, attribution, placement, claims, and change-history exports with declared scope and timing.

faq.question: Does the skill change my ad account?
faq.answer: No. It evaluates evidence and must not change campaigns, bids, budgets, audiences, or settings.

faq.question: What happens when evidence is missing?
faq.answer: Applicable missing evidence becomes unknown. Required unknowns produce an UNDECIDED result without a comparable total score.

faq.question: Which audit profile should I choose?
faq.answer: Choose direct response, prospecting, or incremental profit according to the declared business goal.

faq.question: Is platform ROAS enough for a decision?
faq.answer: No. The audit reconciles platform reporting with deduplicated business outcomes, economics, attribution timing, and incrementality evidence.

faq.question: Can a standalone installation calculate a score?
faq.answer: No. Without the validated root scorer, it collects observations and returns a not-scored, undecided result.
